name: Developmental Edit
description: Declarative developmental-edit template. Workflow execution is not implemented and must not modify novel data.

stages.title: Story Goal
stages.intent: Name the dramatic question the book is actually asking.

stages.title: Plot Structure
stages.intent: Map major turns and test whether they escalate.

stages.title: Character Arc
stages.intent: Track starting state, pressure, and a candidate ending state.

stages.title: Conflict
stages.intent: Identify external opposition and internal contradiction.

stages.title: Stakes
stages.intent: Make loss concrete for person, relationship, or world.

stages.title: Pacing
stages.intent: Judge whether middle motion is delay or development.

stages.title: Theme
stages.intent: Note recurring values without forcing a slogan.

stages.title: Revision Plan
stages.intent: Produce ordered human-approved revision intents. Do not apply them.
